verdict.rationale: Docs show a quickstart with copy-paste code (sgMail.setApiKey, sample code in multiple languages) and the v3 Mail Send REST endpoint, plus cURL and SMTP alternatives (sendgrid-docs-1,14,17,20,15). However, the evidence never confirms that the API response includes a message ID for tracking — tracking is instead handled via a separate Event Webhook setup, not a returned ID in the send call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a message-id field returned by the Mail Send API call, and independent hands-on confirmation of the one-call flow.
